description: Apply a client-authored Living Panels revision without using a server revision LLM. Targeted changes regenerate only inferred dirty producer nodes such as panel:<id>, motion:<id>, or tts:<bubble_id>.

base_story_hash.description: Hash from comic_revision_brief. Prevents applying a patch over a stale story.
base_story_hash.title: Base Story Hash

changes.description: Targeted changes. Prefer this over full story replacement for small edits.

path.description: Allowed Story JSON path from comic_revision_brief, e.g. pages[0].panels[1].cells[0].art.
path.title: Path

value.description: Replacement value for the target path.
value.title: Value

changes.title: Changes

client_model.description: Model or agent that authored the revision, for provenance.
client_model.title: Client Model

client_name.description: Host app or client name, for provenance.
client_name.title: Client Name

dirty_nodes.description: Optional extra producer nodes, e.g. panel:p2u1, motion:p2u1, tts:p2u1a-b0.
dirty_nodes.title: Dirty Nodes

start_production.description: Regenerate inferred dirty assets after saving.
start_production.title: Start Production

story.description: Optional full replacement Story JSON. Targeted changes are cheaper/faster when possible.
story.title: Story

name: comic_submit_revision
title: Submit client comic revision
